name: lying biceps curl with towel
description: Lie on your back and curl a towel held in both hands toward your chest, using your own resistance to work the biceps.
instructions: Lie on your back and hold a towel in both hands, arms extended.
Pull the towel taut and curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms still and your elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.
